fight.feedEmpty: Nothing yet: actions show up here as you play.
fight.idleHelp: It starts by itself when the first player rolls initiative from their sheet. Anyone who comes later joins anyway.
fight.pastEmpty: Fights you play show up here, with their rounds and how they ended.
fight.rollHelp: Type the number the die shows: the sheet adds your bonus ({{bonus}}).
fight.moved: The fight has already changed: look again and retry.
fight.tooLate: Too late to undo: the fight has moved on.
fight.failed: That didn't go through: try again in a moment.
fight.anyonePasses: Anyone can pass the turn: if someone is distracted, the fight doesn't stall.

suggest.enemies-defeated: Every enemy is down. End the fight?
suggest.rest: The party rested. End the fight?
suggest.idle: Nobody has touched the fight for an hour. End it?

fight.rollMissingDone: Rolled for everyone missing: they're all in the order now.

dm.pcRule: A character takes damage by their own rules (resistances, temporary HP, Concentration). They mark healing on their sheet.
